title: Design: Complete internal work order shows Close Work Order as the header button
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have a new internal work order for that customer with every line Complete, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow1-14-05-work-order-complete-ready-to-close.png, iwo-happy-16-16-complete-ready-to-close.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The blue header button reads "Close Work Order" (Title Case) where Create invoice is on a billable work order.
  • Close Work Order is not in the three-dots menu.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-R1: “On an internal or no-charge work order, every place that offers "Create invoice" on a billable work order offers "Close Work Order" instead (Title Case, like Create Work Order, the same label everywhere) and opens the confirmation of S3-R2: the header button (on mobile, the icon button with the tooltip "Close Work Order"), the three-dots menu (only while it would hold Create invoice, S3-N2), the Create invoice action on the Finance tab, the finish action of the lines bulk bar, and the completion wizard of Simple Mode wherever it offers Create invoice (on these work orders the wizard shows no core amount and no "to invoice" wording). No path on these work orders creates a billable invoice. "Mark Reviewed" is unchanged.”
  • S3-N2: “With review off and open lines, Close Work Order sits in the three-dots menu exactly as Create invoice does today; once every line is Complete it is the header button and leaves the menu, as Create invoice does.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 1 · Create and close" / "Happy flow v6", boards "05 Work order · Complete, ready to close" (Flow 1 · Create and close), "16 Complete, ready to close" (Happy flow v6).
